notes.title: Version 2.27 is here. Ready to save the Earth?
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! We have uploaded version 2.27 of Elva the Eco Dragon.

- Better controllers with enhanced smooth movements.
- Now you can change the Y axis on config.
- Reposition Elva to her original point while playing (R, right stick click).
- Recompiled textures for better view and HDR active.
- These changes are active now on Steam and Nintendo Switch.

And more things to come soon. Thank you!

notes.title: New way of processing radioactive materials
notes.notes: Hello there! We have released a new patch, that includes some changes to controllers and graphics, and most important, we have changed the way the radioactive materials are processed. Now when a radioactive material is active the siren won't be making noise all the time, only some seconds. And no matter what material is, if it is radioactive it will always go to the ship or the airplane to be processed. More coming soon. Thanks!

notes.title: Elva the Eco Dragon to be removed from Steam.
notes.notes:
We would like to inform that the game Elva the Eco Dragon will be removed from the Steam store. This children's and youth game has not satisfied the players, so the game will be removed from sale. 

We have already contacted with Steam to proceed removing the game.

Whoever has the game will be able to continue playing it, and of course you can count on us for doubts and consultations. The decision is irrevocable and will be carried out as soon as Steam proceeds to its removal. 

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Elva the Eco Dragon 1.5: the space's the limit!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi! Elva is back![/b]

We have released version 1.5 of Elva the Eco Dragon, with a new scenario: Space debris.

"Space debris" is the new scenario for Elva the Eco Dragon. in this scenario we leave the Earth and start our work with Elva in orbit around the planet. After cleaning the Earth, we'll go to the Moon, back to the Earth, and then finally to Saturn.

Cleaning the space debris won't be the unique task to complete. We'll have to save the Space station in orbit around the Earth. A group of asteroids moving towards the space station must be stopped before the asteroids impact into the station and break down its shield.

You can see our new video to see the features of "Space debris". And remember that we're also working with the new scenario: "Climate change".

[previewyoutube=wz0R85gy334;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Elva the Eco Dragon 1.5: the space's the limit!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/8eec1c2624ebe56d97f36d20d0316ce7e874a80f.png[/img]

[b]"Elva the Eco Dragon" version 1.5: it is about space. And it is about time.[/b]

"Elva the Eco Dragon" version 1.5 [/b] is now available!

"Space debris" is the new scenario for "Elva the Eco Dragon". in this scenario we leave the Earth and start our work with Elva in orbit around the planet. After cleaning the Earth, we'll go to the Moon, back to the Earth, and then finally to Saturn.

Cleaning the space debris won't be the unique task to complete. We'll have to save the Space station in orbit around the Earth. A group of asteroids moving towards the space station must be stopped before the asteroids impact into the station and break down its shield.

The same will be for the starship around the Moon and Saturn. And if you fail to save the space station or the starship the game will finish without saving the results.

Now the game has been adapted for 4K monitors, and you can play at that resolution. This video has been captured that way.

[previewyoutube=wz0R85gy334;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, we are preparing new scenarios, the next one will be called "Climate change". Elva has grown up, and has a critical task: to save thousands of animals from a catastrophe. You can see an ingame image of what the scenario will look like (WIP):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/5a19843e30b08050c58d1e4bdf1ef20cfd02b78b.png[/img]

Show the children that we can clean and save the planet. This game intends to show that our planet is beautiful, and we must protect it. Your help will be invaluable to us.

We' re going to release new videos that are now recorded with tons of new features. Please stay tuned and don't forget to clean your city, your village, your world.

Thank you!

notes.title: "Elva the Eco Dragon" new price!
notes.notes:
[b]Elva has a new price![/b]

While we prepare the next chapter for "Elva the Eco Dragon" that will be set on the sea, we have dropped the game price so everyone can enjoy cleaning the planet with your family and friends!

Elva, the Eco Dragon, is an adventure that seeks to influence the environmental awareness of children. The protagonist is Elva, a dragon from another galaxy whose purpose is to clean up the planet from human pollution. With her they will travel by land, sea and air, as well as to the earth's orbit, to fulfill all kinds of missions related to the care of the Earth.

[b]Collect waste and recycle.[/b]

Like Elva, players will collect waste for recycling and accumulating points. They'll find everything from household trash to toxic waste to space travel debris. The reward will vary depending on how many units of each type you collect. Other ways to help the planet offered by the game include popularizing paper bags, reforesting the map and saving the lives of endangered aquatic animals. You can also clean up areas inhabited by viruses and harmful bacteria.

The cumulative score on Steam will move you up the world rankings for caregivers. While there is no direct competition, Elva, the Eco Dragon will try to use this feature to make the missions more attractive.

[b]Present and future. Next stop: the Moon.[/b]

The game will have seven levels in Spanish and English, although and now five of them are ready to be played on Steam, and the rest will come later as a free game update. 

The new level is called "Moon Helium": clean the Moon from debris left by the space ships coming from different countries, and collect samples of Helium to be sent to Earth for the next fusion reactors. This area is now available at no cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/ca237ba7cae445591993aa3f553373e05a50b92e.jpg[/img]

[b]A game for the family to learn how to take care of the planet.[/b]

In the end, "Elva the Eco Dragon" has two missions: being a way of have fun, but also have fun while entertaining and showing how to take care of the planet. A game for everyone, from the little ones in the house to grandparents.

The most important mission starts when the game ends: cleaning up the Earth. But the game never ends, because every day we must keep our mind with the healthcare of the planet. Thank you, and enjoy "Elva the Eco Dragon".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/85efad10582f8770c4d995dc92a41be9e82e8907.jpg[/img]

We are happy to inform that the new version of "Elva the Eco Dragon" is now available for download. This version arrives with a new Scenery: "Helium & Moon".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/ca237ba7cae445591993aa3f553373e05a50b92e.jpg[/img]

[b]Helium & Moon.[/b]

Collect samples of rock that will generate Helium to be sent to Earth. Helium on the Moon will be a new way of generating clean energy with the fusion reactors now in development. That will give the planet a powerful way of generating electricity with no dangerous consequences.

[b]Other elements.[/b]


The game now has a new feature in config menu: you can replay won levels with the sceneries of your choice that have been activated. That way you can get new ecopoints and other challenges in sceneries where the challenges were others before.

And remember: you can configure the keyboard and pad while playing with the "m" button or left pad button, and calibrate the pad the way you like it. Thank you!

notes.title: Main info about Elva and betatesters
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/82db351948ad986832846915b830d37c30cdadba.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/fa117b27d32c40abf0edd3fad3cf1c5caa260621.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Hello there![/b]


This is our first entry for "Elva the Eco Dragon" and, first of all, we want to thank to all those people that have been in contact with us with questions and ideas for the game. 

As you know, "Elva the Eco Dragon" will be released as Early Release, but this doesn't mean a game with lot of bugs and a poor experience. We are working hard to release this game with many features added from day one, and those features are available in documents in our page and on IndieDB. Images, texts and videos that show the game running, even a complete interactive tutorial.

But, of course, showing images and videos is one thing, actually playing the game is another story. We know that, we are indie developers, but we are also players. 

For that reason we want to give a game that can be played from day one with all the main features finished. And we're happy to inform that we have all those main features finished and testing.

Would you like to be a betatester and try it for yourself? Soon we'll be announcing the date the first beta will available, and that will be very soon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37495303/85efad10582f8770c4d995dc92a41be9e82e8907.jpg[/img]

But May 8th remains as the data to release the game. An Early release for a game that will contain four initial areas completely finished, while we're working in new areas.

Want more details? You can visit our [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/elva-the-eco-dragon]IndieDB page[/url] for the game, or [url=https://elvatheecodragon.com/]our Elva page[/url], for more info. You'll see a lot of info there. We have a FAQ, tutorials, and the campaing info. We'll be updating that info very often too.

So that's all for now, thank you for your interest. And remember: cleaning up the planet can be a game too. A game to survive and live in a better world. Thank you!
